title: thelypteris pseudocuneata
intro: Thelypteris pseudocuneata, commonly known as the forked fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Thelypteris pseudocuneata include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
